PostToolUse.description: Suggest updating card after git commit mentioning trello

hooks.prompt: I see you've committed Trello-related code. Should I update a Trello card with this progress or move it to the next list (e.g., In-Progress -> Done)?

PreToolUse.description: Check for related Trello cards before editing trello-plugin files

hooks.prompt: Before making changes to the Trello plugin, would you like me to check Trello for any related cards or tasks?
